segment.source: Goodbye.<end>
segment.target: Goodbye.<end>

segment.source:
::This humanoid creature turns its head to look at you with its dark, empty eyes. After some hesitation, it slowly approaches you and inspects you from top to bottom. Tentacles which grow on its head move independently from each other, like worms emerging from a handful of dirt, and act fully independent of the creature's other motions.
Speaking of motions, the creature stops making any, instead turning nearly frozen yet still maintaining the amazed stare.::<end>
segment.target:
::This humanoid creature turns its head to look at you with its dark, empty eyes. After some hesitation, it slowly approaches you and inspects you from top to bottom. Tentacles which grow on its head move independently from each other, like worms emerging from a handful of dirt, and act fully independent of the creature's other motions.
Speaking of motions, the creature stops making any, instead turning nearly frozen yet still maintaining the amazed stare.::<end>

segment.source: Can you speak?<end>
segment.target: Can you speak?<end>

segment.source:
::Response comes in a form of a wet, gurgly voice.::
Yes.<end>
segment.target:
::Response comes in a form of a wet, gurgly voice.::
Yes.<end>

segment.source: Who... or what are you?<end>
segment.target: Who... or what are you?<end>

segment.source:
::It makes a brief pause.::
I am me.<end>
segment.target:
::It makes a brief pause.::
I am me.<end>

segment.source: Yes, but *what* are you? Are you... human?<end>
segment.target: Yes, but *what* are you? Are you... human?<end>

segment.source:
::The creature thinks about your question; the tentacles still move and twist around on its head, symbolizing its thought process in a peculiar way.::
*Human*? We were never called *human* before. The Keepers often call us... *Rejects*. Is that the answer you were looking for?<end>
segment.target:
::The creature thinks about your question; the tentacles still move and twist around on its head, symbolizing its thought process in a peculiar way.::
*Human*? We were never called *human* before. The Keepers often call us... *Rejects*. Is that the answer you were looking for?<end>

segment.source:
::It doesn't wait for your answer before proceeding.::
<end>
segment.target:
::It doesn't wait for your answer before proceeding.::
<end>

segment.source: You look like a Keeper, but you don't act like a Keeper <end>
segment.target: You look like a Keeper, but you don't act like a Keeper <end>

segment.source: - you are different. What will you do to me?<end>
segment.target: - you are different. What will you do to me?<end>

segment.source: I mean you no harm.<end>
segment.target: I mean you no harm.<end>

segment.source: Then... why are you here? And where are the Keepers?<end>
segment.target: Then... why are you here? And where are the Keepers?<end>

segment.source: They won't be bothering us for a while.<end>
segment.target: They won't be bothering us for a while.<end>

segment.source: I don't understand. Why are you here?<end>
segment.target: I don't understand. Why are you here?<end>

segment.source: <end>
segment.target: <end>

segment.source: ::[Persuasion]:: Look, this place is very bad for you and you must leave. Please trust me - anywhere is better than here.<end>
segment.target: ::[Persuasion]:: Look, this place is very bad for you and you must leave. Please trust me - anywhere is better than here.<end>

segment.source:
::The creature is still, excluding the independent tentacles on its head and occasional blinking. However, it makes its decision quickly.::
<end>
segment.target:
::The creature is still, excluding the independent tentacles on its head and occasional blinking. However, it makes its decision quickly.::
<end>

segment.source: <end>
segment.target: <end>

segment.source: You haven't hurt us *yet,* and despite me being... afraid, I will trust you. But how will we get out? Is there a way?<end>
segment.target: You haven't hurt us *yet,* and despite me being... afraid, I will trust you. But how will we get out? Is there a way?<end>

segment.source: There is a ventilation shaft in a corner just down the corridor. You can use it to escape. Once you go through it you will find yourself in a dark place. It is dangerous, but if you escape from there you will be able to enjoy your freedom.<end>
segment.target: There is a ventilation shaft in a corner just down the corridor. You can use it to escape. Once you go through it you will find yourself in a dark place. It is dangerous, but if you escape from there you will be able to enjoy your freedom.<end>

segment.source: How will we escape?<end>
segment.target: How will we escape?<end>

segment.source: There is a large hole in one of the floors that leads to freedom. It is approximately to the west from where you emerge from the ventilation shaft, but you will have to go around to the south first.<end>
segment.target: There is a large hole in one of the floors that leads to freedom. It is approximately to the west from where you emerge from the ventilation shaft, but you will have to go around to the south first.<end>

segment.source: I understand. I hope we are doing the right thing.<end>
segment.target: I understand. I hope we are doing the right thing.<end>

segment.source: Thank you and... goodbye. Say goodbye to the Keepers for us.<end>
segment.target: Thank you and... goodbye. Say goodbye to the Keepers for us.<end>

segment.source: ::[Stealth]:: Goodbye. I'll sneak you to the vent one by one, then you're on your own. You first...<end>
segment.target: ::[Stealth]:: Goodbye. I'll sneak you to the vent one by one, then you're on your own. You first...<end>

segment.source: Goodbye and good luck.<end>
segment.target: Goodbye and good luck.<end>

segment.source: You wait here while I figure that out. I'll get back to you.<end>
segment.target: You wait here while I figure that out. I'll get back to you.<end>

segment.source: We will. <end>
segment.target: We will. <end>

segment.source: ::The creature raises its malformed hand and waves you goodbye.::<end>
segment.target: ::The creature raises its malformed hand and waves you goodbye.::<end>

segment.source: I don't know. That is up to you.<end>
segment.target: I don't know. That is up to you.<end>

segment.source: We will try to find it. You have already helped us more than enough.<end>
segment.target: We will try to find it. You have already helped us more than enough.<end>

segment.source: I'll find you a safe way out. I promise.<end>
segment.target: I'll find you a safe way out. I promise.<end>

segment.source: Thank you. I hope the Keepers don't return before you do.<end>
segment.target: Thank you. I hope the Keepers don't return before you do.<end>

segment.source: I am afraid. We get hurt here, but we know when and know how. Somewhere else though... ::He pauses.:: Thank you, but we stay here.<end>
segment.target: I am afraid. We get hurt here, but we know when and know how. Somewhere else though... ::He pauses.:: Thank you, but we stay here.<end>

segment.source: Look, this place is very bad for you and you must leave. Please trust me - anywhere is better than here. I've got someone waiting for you outside, a rogue Keeper. Don't be scared, he's like me, he wants to help you.<end>
segment.target: Look, this place is very bad for you and you must leave. Please trust me - anywhere is better than here. I've got someone waiting for you outside, a rogue Keeper. Don't be scared, he's like me, he wants to help you.<end>

segment.source: Get out of here, I unlocked the cell doors!<end>
segment.target: Get out of here, I unlocked the cell doors!<end>

segment.source: Where would we go? Swifty tried to run away when the Keepers came for him... and they ended him for that.<end>
segment.target: Where would we go? Swifty tried to run away when the Keepers came for him... and they ended him for that.<end>

segment.source: I don't know - go somewhere else but here! Don't you want to be free?<end>
segment.target: I don't know - go somewhere else but here! Don't you want to be free?<end>

segment.source: We have nowhere to go; our whole lives we lived here with the Keepers, and we don't know what "somewhere else" is like. How will we feed? Where will we sleep? Is it too cold? Too hot? Are others who live there just like the Keepers? Or like you?<end>
segment.target: We have nowhere to go; our whole lives we lived here with the Keepers, and we don't know what "somewhere else" is like. How will we feed? Where will we sleep? Is it too cold? Too hot? Are others who live there just like the Keepers? Or like you?<end>

segment.source: Erm... there's a bit of everything.<end>
segment.target: Erm... there's a bit of everything.<end>

segment.source:
::It is this moment when you first notice something in its pitch-black eyes, and that something is fear.::
I don't want to be here. I don't want to be anywhere else. I... don't know what is best for me, or for us. And my siblings... they are like me.<end>
segment.target:
::It is this moment when you first notice something in its pitch-black eyes, and that something is fear.::
I don't want to be here. I don't want to be anywhere else. I... don't know what is best for me, or for us. And my siblings... they are like me.<end>

segment.source: It's a lot better than this place.<end>
segment.target: It's a lot better than this place.<end>

segment.source: I'll find you a way out, hold on tight.<end>
segment.target: I'll find you a way out, hold on tight.<end>

segment.source: What happened to you and why are you locked in here?<end>
segment.target: What happened to you and why are you locked in here?<end>

segment.source: We were always like this, since the day we began. It's what we are. And we are locked because... ::It pauses.:: The Keepers do not allow us to go anywhere. The Keepers tell us that we will get ourselves hurt... or hurt others, that we are not yet ready to leave.<end>
segment.target: We were always like this, since the day we began. It's what we are. And we are locked because... ::It pauses.:: The Keepers do not allow us to go anywhere. The Keepers tell us that we will get ourselves hurt... or hurt others, that we are not yet ready to leave.<end>

segment.source: But I don't like it here. The Keepers sometimes hurt us... or end some of us. Not all of them; some treat us well, but most do not.<end>
segment.target: But I don't like it here. The Keepers sometimes hurt us... or end some of us. Not all of them; some treat us well, but most do not.<end>

segment.source: What exactly do they do to you here?<end>
segment.target: What exactly do they do to you here?<end>

segment.source: They mostly keep us in these spaces. ::It points to the cell it is in.:: Once between two rests we are fed, led to walk and run, and every three or four rests they bring us to a bigger space and take bits of us and make us do "tests." We must obey, or else we are punished.<end>
segment.target: They mostly keep us in these spaces. ::It points to the cell it is in.:: Once between two rests we are fed, led to walk and run, and every three or four rests they bring us to a bigger space and take bits of us and make us do "tests." We must obey, or else we are punished.<end>

segment.source: Some siblings are led away by the Keepers to be ended, but new siblings always come. Always.<end>
segment.target: Some siblings are led away by the Keepers to be ended, but new siblings always come. Always.<end>

segment.source: I have to change the subject.<end>
segment.target: I have to change the subject.<end>

segment.source: Alright.<end>
segment.target: Alright.<end>

segment.source: Do you have a name?<end>
segment.target: Do you have a name?<end>

segment.source: Name? ::He stops to think before responding.:: What is your name?<end>
segment.target: Name? ::He stops to think before responding.:: What is your name?<end>

segment.source: I'm $(context.player.Name).<end>
segment.target: I'm $(context.player.Name).<end>

segment.source: I have been called many names so far: Reject, Bastard, Freak, Inbred... but I don't like any of those. The tone they were said in sounded harsh. One Keeper once said I was, "pretty sharp for a Reject," so my siblings started calling me... Sharp.<end>
segment.target: I have been called many names so far: Reject, Bastard, Freak, Inbred... but I don't like any of those. The tone they were said in sounded harsh. One Keeper once said I was, "pretty sharp for a Reject," so my siblings started calling me... Sharp.<end>

segment.source: I like that a lot more.<end>
segment.target: I like that a lot more.<end>

segment.source: I asked you first.<end>
segment.target: I asked you first.<end>

segment.source: How old are you?<end>
segment.target: How old are you?<end>

segment.source: I don't know what you mean.<end>
segment.target: I don't know what you mean.<end>

segment.source: Your age; how many years have passed since you were born.<end>
segment.target: Your age; how many years have passed since you were born.<end>

segment.source: I don't know how long a "year" lasts; I have heard the word. But if it means something to you, I am the oldest one of us here.<end>
segment.target: I don't know how long a "year" lasts; I have heard the word. But if it means something to you, I am the oldest one of us here.<end>

segment.source: Have you lived for a long or short time?<end>
segment.target: Have you lived for a long or short time?<end>

segment.source: To me it seems long... but I don't know how that compares to you. I just thought of something... siblings and I do not age the same as the Keepers. We change faster than them; I noticed it on the Keepers with real faces.<end>
segment.target: To me it seems long... but I don't know how that compares to you. I just thought of something... siblings and I do not age the same as the Keepers. We change faster than them; I noticed it on the Keepers with real faces.<end>

segment.source: You mean without masks?<end>
segment.target: You mean without masks?<end>

segment.source: I think we mean the same.<end>
segment.target: I think we mean the same.<end>

segment.source: I understand. I had more questions.<end>
segment.target: I understand. I had more questions.<end>

segment.source: ::Its dark eyes are watching you.::<end>
segment.target: ::Its dark eyes are watching you.::<end>

segment.source: I get it, I get it... I'll be leaving you now.<end>
segment.target: I get it, I get it... I'll be leaving you now.<end>

segment.source: Real faces?<end>
segment.target: Real faces?<end>

segment.source: ::It pauses to think.:: Real like... theirs... uncovered. That is what I mean.<end>
segment.target: ::It pauses to think.:: Real like... theirs... uncovered. That is what I mean.<end>

segment.source: I see... I had other questions.<end>
segment.target: I see... I had other questions.<end>

segment.source: Questions?<end>
segment.target: Questions?<end>

segment.source: Is there more of you other than the few here?<end>
segment.target: Is there more of you other than the few here?<end>

segment.source: Yes. I have seen more siblings before, but sometimes only for a short time, then never again.<end>
segment.target: Yes. I have seen more siblings before, but sometimes only for a short time, then never again.<end>

segment.source: They are either ended or moved.<end>
segment.target: They are either ended or moved.<end>

segment.source: Goodbye.<end>
segment.target: Goodbye.<end>

segment.source: I am here to remove the burden of life from you. ::Attack!::<end>
segment.target: I am here to remove the burden of life from you. ::Attack!::<end>

segment.source: You are not like the Keepers <end>
segment.target: You are not like the Keepers <end>

segment.source: ::Leave it be.::<end>
segment.target: ::Leave it be.::<end>

segment.source: ::It cautiously observes you.::<end>
segment.target: ::It cautiously observes you.::<end>
